messages:
noah: Quick flag — vuln scanner found a setgid bit in our slim base used by api-runtime. digest: sha256:deadbeefcafebabe. Not promoted but signer shows prod key. Need RBAC + audit plan before any rollout.
yasmin: Can you paste cosign verify?
noah: ```
$ cosign verify gcr.io/redwood/api-runtime:slim-2026-03-24
Verified OK : sha256:deadbeefcafebabe
Signed by: ci-pipeline@redwood
Key: projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/img-keys/cryptoKeys/prod-deploy/cryptoKeyVersions/9
```
eli: That's problematic. CI shouldn't have prod-deploy signing. ops-bot, show KMS bindings for that key.
ops-bot: KMS IAM: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner -> members: serviceAccount:ci-pipeline@redwood, group:key-admins@redwood
sec-bot: image-scan: MEDIUM severity: setgid binary /usr/local/bin/agent (CWE-250). world-writable /var/tmp flagged.
yasmin: Short-term: add digest to promotion denylist and mark builds from ci-pipeline as untrusted. ops-bot can you add denylist?
ops-bot: denylist updated: sha256:deadbeefcafebabe added (TTL 72h)
noah: I can rebuild quickly: strip setuid/setgid, use nonroot user, and add attestation metadata with pipeline id. Example Dockerfile snippet: ```Dockerfile
FROM gcr.io/distroless/static:nonroot
COPY --from=builder /out/agent /usr/local/bin/agent
USER 65532:65532
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/agent"]
```
eli: For IAM: propose creating an ephemeral signer SA (ephemeral-signer@redwood) and adding an IAM condition on prod-deploy key: only allow signer when request.auth.claim.pipeline == "deploy" and request.time within approval window. Also require 2 approvers for granting that claim.
yasmin: I'll file SEC-3602 to rotate key bindings and implement the approval workflow. Also need BQ export of cloudkms.sign logs for 13 months.
noah: Runtime mitigation: add a container prestart hook that executes `cosign verify` and emits a structured audit event with fields: image, digest, signer, keyversion. If verify fails, block start. We should also have a metric image.verify.fail.
eli: Good. Add to that an admission controller that checks attestation predicate includes pipeline id and git commit.
sec-bot: Suggested quick runbook attached: 1) denylist digest, 2) revoke ci-pipeline key permissions, 3) snapshot builder vm, 4) rebuild non-root + strip suid bits, 5) sign with rotated key + attest, 6) enable runtime verify hook, 7) export KMS audit logs.
yasmin: Meeting 30min from now to coordinate. I'll assign tasks in the ticket and post timeline here.
noah: Thanks — updating the ticket with rebuilt image digest when ready.
ops-bot: ticket SEC-3602 created and assigned to yasmin, eli.
eli: I'll draft the IAM condition and approval policy before the sync.
